buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of District Magistrate, Murshidabad payable at District Magistrate, Murshidabad . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC) For transportation of rice / fortified rice under WBNP from FCI / DCF&S godown of anywhere in Murshidabad / Malda / Nadia / Birbhum District to different ICDS Projects godown under Murshidabad District for one year from the date of agreement. 1. Scope of Work The contractor shall undertake loading, unloading, transportation/carrying, pres ervation and delivery of WBNP rice from FCI / DCF&S godown of anywhere in Mu rshidabad / Malda / Nadia / Birbhum district to different ICDS Projects godowns

as directed by the District Programme Officer (ICDS). The bidder shall quote rat es for all four (4) Districts (Murshidabad / Malda / Nadia / Birbhum). Submission of rates for all four Districts is mandatory. Failure to quote rates for any one or more of the four Districts shall render the bid liable to rejection. The consignee's address provided in the bid document shall be disregarded. The quoted rate sh all be inclusive of loading, unloading, labour, transportation, handling, insurance , taxes, duties and all incidental charges unless otherwise specifically provided. Total consignment for one year is approximately 16000 mt rice. Bid value: Rs. 1 9400000/-. Earnest money Rs. 3,88,000/- (Rupees : three lakh eighty eight thousand) only has to be deposited by the bidder. 2. Experience Criteria For qualification, the bidder shall satisfy either of the following criteria: (i) The intending tenderer shall submit credential(s) in support of having successfully completed at least o ne work of a similar nature involving the carrying of foodstuffs under a Government Department during an y one of the last five financial years, namely 2021–22, 2022–23, 2023–24, 2024–25 or 2025–26, with a mini mum value of ₹ 97,00,000/- (Rupees : Ninety-Seven Lakh) only towards the transport/carrying of foodstuff component. OR (ii) The intending tenderer shall submit credentials in support of having successfully completed at least tw o works of a similar nature involving the carrying of foodstuffs under a Government Department during any one of the last five financial years, namely 2021–22, 2022–23, 2023–24, 2024–25 or 2025–26, with a minim um value of ₹ 72,75,000/- (Rupees : Seventy-Two Lakh Seventy-Five Thousand) only towards the transport/ carryingof foodstuff component for each work. The bidder shall upload copies of Work Orders along with Completion Certificate s / Performance Certificate(s) / Work Completion Report(s) or equivalent docum entary evidence establishing successful completion. 3. Financial Eligibility The bidder shall upload: ● Audited Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss Account for the last three financ ial years (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). ● PAN Card. ● GST Registration Certificate and latest return (at least June, 2026). ● Professional Tax Registration and latest return (at least March, 2026). ● Similar nature of Trade Licence (Transport/carrying of food stuff). ● Income Tax Return of the last three financial years (2023-24,2024-25, 20 25-26) 4. Delivery The bidder shall submit documentary evidence of ownership of multiple vehicles suitable for transportation of foodgrains. Alternatively, the bidder may submit a valid agreement with a duly registered transport agency for the provisi on of the required vehicles. The contractor shall complete transportation and delivery within the period spe cified by the concerned authority. Digital weighing machines shall be used wherever required.

Delivery challans shall be prepared for every consignment and acknowledged b y the receiving authority. 5. Safety of Stock The contractor shall remain fully responsible for any loss, theft, pilferage, deteri oration, moisture damage, rodent damage or other loss occurring while the stoc k remains in his custody. 6. Records The contractor shall maintain: ● Delivery Register ● Receipt Register ● Vehicle Movement Register ● Acknowledgement Records The records shall be produced for inspection whenever required by the Procurin g Entity. 7. Statutory Compliance The contractor shall comply with all applicable provisions of: ● General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017. ● West Bengal Financial Rules. ● Relevant Government of West Bengal Finance Department Orders. ● Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) Guidelines, wherever applicable. ● GeM General Terms & Conditions. ● Labour laws, GST laws and other statutory provisions. 8. Integrity Declaration The bidder shall certify that: ● It has not been debarred or blacklisted by any Government Department, PSU, Autonomous Body or Local Authority as on the last date of submissio n of bid; ● It has not been convicted for offences involving fraud, corruption, briber y, collusive bidding or moral turpitude. ● All information furnished in the bid is true and correct. Submission of false information shall lead to rejection of the bid and such other action as permissible under law. 9. Clarification of Documents The competent authority may seek clarification or verification of documents sub mitted by the bidder wherever considered necessary. Failure to furnish satisfact ory clarification within the stipulated period may render the bid liable for rejecti

on. 10. Evaluation Only substantially responsive bids fulfilling the published eligibility and qualifica tion criteria shall be considered for financial evaluation. The quoted rate per me tric tonne (MT) for transportation shall be considered for bid evaluation. 11. Abnormally Low Bid Where the quoted rate appears to be abnormally low, the Tender Evaluation Co mmittee may seek written justification from the bidder. If the explanation is fou nd unsatisfactory, the bid may be rejected for recording reasons. 12. Performance Security The successful bidder shall furnish Performance Security Rs. 5,82,000/ - (Rupees : five lakh eighty two thousand) only as prescribed in the bid document before execution of the agreement. 13. Contract Period The contract shall remain valid for one year from the date of execution of the agreement and may be extended in accordance with Governmen t orders and the terms of the contract based on satisfactory performan ce. 14. Right of the Procuring Entity The Authority reserves the right to accept or reject any or all bids or cancel the bidding process at any stage without assigning any reason, subject to the applic able procurement rules. 15. Jurisdiction Any dispute arising out of this contract shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the competent courts in the State of West Bengal. ANNEXURE A – LIST OF REQUIRED DOCUMENTS A. Statutory Documents (must be uploaded at the folder “Additional D oc 1”) 1. Bid Submission Application to Participate. 2. Bid Security / Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) or Bid Security Declaration. Ea rnest money (as specified) has to be deposited by the bidder. 3. Permanent Account Number (PAN). 4. GST Registration Certificate. 5. GST Latest return (as specified). 6. Professional Tax Registration Certificate. 7. Latest Professional Tax Return (as specified). 8. Income Tax Returns for the last three financial years (as specified). 9. Valid Trade Licence of similar nature (Transport /Carrying of food stuff). 10. Certificate of Incorporation / Partnership Deed / LLP Registration / Proprieto rship Declaration, as applicable. 11. Power of Attorney / Board Resolution authorising the person signing the bid , wherever applicable.

12. Vehicle related document (as specified). B. Experience / Technical Qualification Documents (must be uploaded a t the folder “Experience Criteria”) 1. Completion Certificate(s) / Performance Certificate(s) issued by the competent authority as stated. 2. Bidder’s Name, Address and Contact Details for verification. C. Financial Documents and Banking Details (must be uploaded at the folder “Additional Doc 2”) 1. Audited Balance Sheet (as specified). 2. Profit & Loss Account (as specified). 3. Average Annual Turnover Certificate issued by a Chartered Accountant. 4. Cancelled Cheque. 5. Name and Address of Banker. 6. Bank Account Number and IFSC Code. D. Declarations & Undertakings (must be uploaded at the folder “Certif icate”) 1. Bidder's undertaking regarding correctness of information. 2. Declaration regarding Non-Blacklisting / Non-Debarment. 3. Declaration regarding Non-Conviction. 4. Acceptance of all Bid Terms & Conditions. Notes: 1. Original documents shall be produced for verification whenever demanded by the Authority. 2. Bidders shall upload all required documents (as specified in annexure A) st rictly in accordance with the provisions of this ATC. Non-compliance with th ese requirements may lead to the rejection or cancellation of the bid. 3. All documents submitted by the bidder shall be serially marked an d indexed on the upper-right-hand corner of each document in acc ordance with Annexure-A. For example, Declaration regarding Non -Conviction shall be marked as “D-3”, as specified in Annexure-A. 4. Payment for the transportation services shall be made only upon the availa bility of funds and in accordance with the applicable Government rules and procedures. 5. In the event of any conflict, inconsistency, or contradiction between the pr ovisions of this Bid Document and the GeM Additional Terms and Condition s (ATC), the provisions of the ATC shall prevail and shall be binding. All oth er terms and conditions of the Bid Document, to the extent they are not inc onsistent with the ATC, shall remain unchanged and continue to be in full f orce and effect.

6. The bids/offers submitted in hard copy/ fax/ E-mail etc. shall NOT be considere d/shall be treated as non-responsive. No correspondence will be entertained on this matter. 7. The Procuring Entity reserves the right to verify experience, past performa nce and financial credentials from the issuing authority. 8. Submission of false, forged or misleading information shall render the bid li able for rejection and may invite further action under the applicable procur ement rules. .
